scripts.seed:gen: tsx scripts/gen-seed.ts && tsx scripts/gen-mock.ts && tsx scripts/collect-policies.ts && tsx scripts/build-seed-sql.ts
scripts.seed:local: tsx scripts/build-seed-sql.ts && wrangler d1 execute wealth-mvp1 --local --file data/seed.sql
scripts.seed:remote: tsx scripts/build-seed-sql.ts && wrangler d1 execute wealth-mvp1 --remote --file data/seed.sql
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --var AUTH_MODE:dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.demo:delete: wrangler delete --name wealth-platform && wrangler d1 delete wealth-mvp1
